messages:
Jules M.: Anyone seeing an uptick in 403s for the SAML auth flow? Just noticed at ~03:29 UTC.
Rina S.: Yep saw alerts. Any correlated deploys or config changes?
Jules M.: Looks like the nightly RBAC prune job ran at 03:22 and there were a bunch of SCIM retries right after. Assertion dumps show the role attribute stripped for some users.
Oliver (infra): I pulled mapping-service logs. We have a race: prune job removes stale group mappings, mapping-service received a provisioning webhook with an empty groups list while it was reconciling. It interpreted empty as explicit removal and pushed change to DB.
deploy-bot: Mapping-service v3.12.1 rollout to eu-central completed at 03:18 UTC.
Rina S.: Any KMS-related errors? If claim payloads are encrypted and decryption fails we sometimes drop optional attrs.
Oliver (infra): No KMS decrypt spikes. Only TLS handshakes failed earlier between scim-worker and idp (transient). That probably caused the webhook to contain partial data.
Jules M.: Can we short-term mitigate by pausing RBAC prune? If we disable it, mapping-service won't get aggressive tombstones.
SecOps: Incident created: INC-2026-211 - SAML roles missing after RBAC prune (investigating).
Oliver (infra): I can disable the prune cron via infra toggle. Will do in 2m and restart mapping-service canary to rehydrate mapping cache.
Rina S.: Starting a targeted SCIM backfill for orgs A and B: `scimctl backfill --orgs A,B --preserve-existing` (dry-run first).
Jules M.: Also run a quick audit query to list users with empty roles and last_auth within 24h: `select uid,email from users where roles = '{}' and last_auth > now() - interval '24 hours';`
Rina S.: Dry-run shows ~48 affected accounts, ~6 service accounts. Backfill initiated.
Oliver (infra): Toggle off prune done. Mapping-service canary restarted and shows mapping cache reloaded.
SecOps: Update INC-2026-211: mitigation in progress - prune paused, backfill running.
deploy-bot: Mapping-service canary health: PASS.
Rina S.: Backfill finished: 48 users updated, role attrs present in assertion samples I pulled.
Jules M.: Monitoring auth gateway - error rate down to baseline. Good sign.
Oliver (infra): Follow-ups: add a safety check in prune job to ignore webhook events during active SCIM retries or if SCIM health reports TLS/mTLS issues; add an explicit dry-run step in mapping-service that rejects empty-group payloads unless verified.
Rina S.: I'll add an audit alert on mapping-rule deletions so we get a page if mappings are removed for >5 users.
Jules M.: Can we also add a post-prune smoke test that authenticates a handful of sample users and verifies expected attributes?
Oliver (infra): Yes. I'll open PRs for prune-guard and smoke test.
SecOps: Closing note: incident resolved but keeping INC-2026-211 open until postmortem doc posted. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
